narrative: Material PL1__MB4CB31A exhibits erratic demand with CV=0.62 and unstable lead times (CV_LT=1.39). The optimized policy recommends a safety stock of 918 units to achieve 95% service level. Order quantity is set to 8602 units (constrained by storage capacity from EOQ of 12133). Reorder point is 1775 units with a review period of 20 days. The optimized policy increases annual cost by $70.29 compared to the previous policy, but significantly improves service level protection.
